name: RC-B10-0577/2025 – § 7 – Am 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the mass kidnapping of children in Nigeria, including from St Mary’s Catholic School in Papiri
part_text: 7. Recognises that the targeted attacks against churches and other Christian institutions in Nigeria are driven by Islamist motives; supports the ongoing international efforts to combat terrorist organisations such as Boko Haram and the Islamic State West Africa Province, which are attacking, killing and displacing Nigerians, particularly Christians, and calls on the authorities to take immediate, concrete measures to prevent and respond to their terrorist attacks;
